result.response:
The bug causing an `OutOfMemoryError` during pattern parsing in [`ExtendedMessageFormat`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_43_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormat.java#L417-L425) has been identified and fixed.

### Cause of the Bug
In [`ExtendedMessageFormat.appendQuotedString`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_43_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormat.java#L417-L425), when `escapingOn` was enabled and the character at the current parse position was `QUOTE` (`'`), the method appended `QUOTE` to the output buffer and returned without advancing the `ParsePosition` via `next(pos)`. When called during `applyPattern`, this caused `pos.getIndex()` to remain unchanged at the quote character, resulting in an infinite loop appending quotes until an `OutOfMemoryError` occurred.

### Fix
Added `next(pos);` before returning from `appendQuotedString` when `escapingOn && c[start] == QUOTE` in [`ExtendedMessageFormat.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_43_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormat.java#L421-L424).

The focused patch has been saved to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_43_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch).
